details: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark interest rate steady at 3.50%-3.75% on July 29, 2026. However, Chair Kevin Warsh is reportedly considering reducing the number of annual policy meetings from eight to six starting in 2027, a move that could heighten market volatility around future decisions. In economic data released on August 6, initial jobless claims for the week ending August 1 came in at 199,000, lower than the 204,000 forecast, indicating a persistently tight labor market.

title: Fed Weighs Fewer Meetings in 2027; Jobless Claims Tighten Labor Market

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) kept its key interest rates unchanged on July 23, 2026, with the deposit facility rate at 2.25%. Despite this, market pricing suggests an 88.0% probability of a 25 basis point rate hike at the next ECB meeting on September 9, 2026. The ECB remains committed to its 2% inflation target, closely monitoring energy prices and underlying inflation dynamics.
sourceName: Trading Economics (for current rates and September forecast), European Central Bank (for July decision)
title: ECB Held Rates in July, But September Hike Highly Probable

details: China reported a 4.3% GDP growth for the second quarter of 2026, falling below the 4.5% consensus forecast. This marks China's weakest quarterly GDP growth since late 2022. Concurrently, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange is advancing reforms to expand openness in foreign exchange management, while the People's Bank of China maintains a moderately loose monetary policy to support the real economy.

title: China's Q2 GDP Growth Falls Short; Forex Reforms Progress

details: The 2026 Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium, scheduled for August 27–29, will focus on "Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy." Discussions are expected to cover programmable money, instant settlement, and new private dollar instruments, and their potential influence on central bank policy implementation. Speeches from Federal Reserve officials at the event will be closely watched for insights into the economic outlook, inflation, and future policy direction.
